# SohailWorks

> Sohail Ashraf is a GoHighLevel expert and freelance web developer helping small local businesses in the US and UK capture leads and close deals faster with GoHighLevel funnels, CRM and automation, WordPress websites, and React/Next.js apps. 5+ years of experience, 100+ orders completed, Top Rated on Fiverr.

## Services

- [GoHighLevel Expert Services](https://www.sohailworks.com/gohighlevel-expert): GoHighLevel expert: funnels, landing pages, CRM and pipeline setup, workflow automation, missed-call text-back, booking and appointment automation, lead nurturing and follow-up systems.
- [WordPress Development Services](https://www.sohailworks.com/wordpress-development-services): Custom WordPress websites, Elementor and Elementor Pro, WooCommerce development, custom themes, performance and responsive optimisation.
- [Web App Development Services](https://www.sohailworks.com/web-app-development-services): React.js development, Next.js websites and applications, responsive UI, reusable components, API integration.
